name: v1.58.7 — Fixes and improvements
body:
## What's Changed
* runtimes/js: handle empty buffers in bucket uploads and sqldb params by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2583
* fix(daemon): migration uses wrong context by @ekerfelt in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2585
* cli: allow to create org apps by @ngalaiko in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2586
* cmd: handle optional personal orgs by @ngalaiko in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2587
* .github: build latest release in release mode by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2588
* Update README.md by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2593
* cli: remove Encore.ts intro tutorial from app create templates by @simon-johansson in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2595
* codegen: keep line numbers in rewritten files by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2594
* codegen: fix test builds of files with secrets by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2600
* tsparser: remove stale files from encore.gen by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2599
* all: bump dependencies by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2601
* Update README.md by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2606
* cli: report pending database changes on reload by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2603
* cli/daemon: fix MCP SSE URL printed by 'encore run' by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2614


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/encoredev/encore/compare/v1.58.6...v1.58.7
